spans.s: saumantriṇ-a, n. [sumantrin] 🞄possession of a good minister (conj.).
saum-ika, a. (ī) belonging to Soma 🞄or the Soma sacrifice.

saumitra, m. met. [fr. sumitrā] of 🞄Laksmaṇa;
 n. [sumitra] friendship: i, m. 🞄met. of Lakṣmaṇa: du. Lakṣmaṇa and Śatrughna.

saum-ila, m. N. of a poet;
 -illa, m. id..

saum-ī́, V. a. f. of saumyá;
 f. moonlight 🞄(E.).
